comparator.name: Liberal Arts and Sciences
comparator.sourceNotes: Tilburg University's official 2026-2027 curriculum, checked 2026-09-29, publishes a complete 180-ECTS structure: a 36-ECTS interdisciplinary first-year core plus 24 ECTS in one of three majors; a second year with 12 ECTS of shared courses, 30 ECTS in the selected major and 18 ECTS in one societal theme; and a third year with a 30-ECTS mobility/minor window, Senior Seminar, Societal Capstone and Bachelor Thesis. Because the programme deliberately retains student choice among three majors and three themes and names no default route, these official structured choices are preserved as curriculum components rather than arbitrarily selecting one route. Zero-credit GROW activities are excluded. The credited components total exactly 180 ECTS.

components.name: European History: Politics, Religion, and Culture
Imagining Justice: An Introduction to Law, Politics, and Culture
Our Brain: An Introduction to Cognitive Neuroscience and Behavior
Individuals and Collectives: An Introduction to Interdisciplinary Social Sciences
Year 1 compulsory major courses
components.note: A 24-ECTS structured choice among the official Interdisciplinary Social Sciences, Cognitive Neuroscience and Behavior, or Law, Politics, and Culture major curricula.

components.name: Year 2 major courses
components.note: Thirty ECTS of compulsory and elective coursework within the selected major.

components.name: Year 2 societal-theme courses
components.note: Eighteen ECTS selected within Transformations to Sustainability, Democracy and Justice, or Technology and Society.

components.name: Mobility window or minor
components.note: One official 30-ECTS option: exchange, Humanities and Digital Sciences electives, or an approved minor.

components.name: Societal Capstone
components.note: A real-world project linked to the selected societal theme, often with an external partner.

components.name: Bachelor Thesis
components.note: Independent research within the selected major.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The broad closest match accounts for the shared interdisciplinary core, Interdisciplinary Social Sciences direction and all three societal themes. Cognitive Neuroscience and Behavior and Law, Politics, and Culture remain separate generator-backed directions with coherent feasible UCR curricula. The three completed curricula differ pairwise by well over four courses (30 ECTS), so production reaches the maximum of three alternatives.

notes.text: Tilburg combines a common Liberal Arts and Sciences core with an official major, societal theme and mobility choice. UCR can recreate three coherent interdisciplinary directions, but no single alternative reproduces every prescribed Tilburg major course, theme cluster, capstone partnership or the exact 12-ECTS Bachelor Thesis.
